entries.claim: Historical English source expression: “To thee I come; before thee I stand, sinful and sorrowful” The addressed English wording is revised, not a verbatim quotation.
Historical English source expression: “O Mother of the Word Incarnate! despise not my petitions” The addressed English wording is revised, not a verbatim quotation.
Historical English source expression: “Inspired with this confidence, I fly to thee, O Virgin of virgins, my Mother” The addressed English wording is revised, not a verbatim quotation.

Historical English source expression: “that never was it known that any one who fled to thy protection, implored thy help, and sought thy intercession, was left unaided” The addressed English wording is revised, not a verbatim quotation.
